ddl.value: length("issuer") BETWEEN 1 AND 2048 AND "issuer" ~ '^https://([a-z0-9]([a-z0-9.-]*[a-z0-9])?|\[[0-9a-f:]+\])(:[1-9][0-9]{0,4})?$' AND (substring("issuer" from ':([0-9]+)$') IS NULL OR (substring("issuer" from ':([0-9]+)$')::integer BETWEEN 1 AND 65535 AND (substring("issuer" from ':([0-9]+)$')::integer <> 443))) AND length("instance_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 191 AND "instance_id" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$' AND length("user_id") BETWEEN 6 AND 191 AND "user_id" ~ '^user_[A-Za-z0-9]+$'
ddl.name: chk_account_authority_identity

ddl.value: "observed_generation" >= 0 AND length("environment_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 191 AND "environment_id" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$' AND length("tunnel_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 253 AND "tunnel_name" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$' AND length("endpoint_key") BETWEEN 1 AND 253 AND "endpoint_key" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$' AND length("namespace") BETWEEN 1 AND 191 AND "namespace" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$' AND ("tunnel_id" IS NULL OR (length("tunnel_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 191 AND "tunnel_id" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$')) AND ("dns_record_id" IS NULL OR (length("dns_record_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 191 AND "dns_record_id" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$'))
ddl.name: chk_account_deletion_endpoint_identity

ddl.value: ("reason" IS NULL OR "reason" IN ('endpoint_unverified', 'endpoint_busy', 'endpoint_uncertain')) AND ("hooks_disabled_at" IS NULL OR isfinite("hooks_disabled_at")) AND ("allocation_removed_at" IS NULL OR isfinite("allocation_removed_at"))
ddl.name: chk_account_deletion_endpoint_progress

ddl.value: length("instance_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 191 AND "instance_id" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$' AND length("svix_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 255 AND "svix_id" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$'
ddl.name: chk_account_deletion_event_identity

ddl.value: length("issuer") BETWEEN 1 AND 2048 AND "issuer" ~ '^https://([a-z0-9]([a-z0-9.-]*[a-z0-9])?|\[[0-9a-f:]+\])(:[1-9][0-9]{0,4})?$' AND (substring("issuer" from ':([0-9]+)$') IS NULL OR (substring("issuer" from ':([0-9]+)$')::integer BETWEEN 1 AND 65535 AND (substring("issuer" from ':([0-9]+)$')::integer <> 443))) AND length("instance_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 191 AND "instance_id" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$' AND length("user_id") BETWEEN 6 AND 191 AND "user_id" ~ '^user_[A-Za-z0-9]+$'
ddl.name: chk_account_deletion_identity

ddl.value: "status" IN ('pending', 'blocked_repair', 'complete') AND ("reason" IS NULL OR "reason" IN ('authority_unverified')) AND "attempt_count" >= 0
ddl.name: chk_account_deletion_state

ddl.value: ("status" <> 'complete' OR ("identity_deleted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "local_purged_at" IS NOT NULL AND "completed_at" IS NOT NULL)) AND ("completed_at" IS NULL OR "status" = 'complete')
ddl.name: chk_account_deletion_complete

ddl.value: isfinite("requested_at") AND isfinite("next_attempt_at") AND ("identity_deleted_at" IS NULL OR isfinite("identity_deleted_at")) AND ("revoked_at" IS NULL OR isfinite("revoked_at")) AND ("local_purged_at" IS NULL OR isfinite("local_purged_at")) AND ("completed_at" IS NULL OR isfinite("completed_at"))
ddl.name: chk_account_deletion_times

ddl.value: "lifecycle_state" IN ('idle', 'owned', 'uncertain', 'legacy_unverified') AND ("operation_kind" IS NULL OR "operation_kind" IN ('provision', 'release', 'deprovision', 'reconcile')) AND "tunnel_presence" IN ('unresolved', 'never_created', 'recorded', 'absent') AND "dns_presence" IN ('unresolved', 'never_created', 'recorded', 'absent') AND "generation" >= 0
ddl.name: chk_managed_endpoint_lifecycle_values

ddl.value: ("lifecycle_state" IN ('idle', 'legacy_unverified') AND "operation_id" IS NULL AND "operation_kind" IS NULL AND "operation_started_at" IS NULL AND "pending_mutation" IS NULL) OR ("lifecycle_state" IN ('owned', 'uncertain') AND "operation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "operation_kind" IS NOT NULL AND "operation_started_at" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: chk_managed_endpoint_owner

ddl.value: ("tunnel_presence" <> 'recorded' OR "tunnel_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("dns_presence" <> 'recorded' OR ("dns_record_id" IS NOT NULL AND "dns_target_tunnel_id" IS NOT NULL))
ddl.name: chk_managed_endpoint_recorded_presence

ddl.value:
"pending_mutation" IS NULL OR COALESCE((
  jsonb_typeof("pending_mutation") = 'object'
  AND octet_length("pending_mutation"::text) <= 2048
  AND ("pending_mutation"->>'stepId') ~ '^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$'
  AND (
    ("pending_mutation"->>'action' = 'create_tunnel' AND "pending_mutation" - ARRAY['action', 'stepId', 'tunnelName']::text[] = '{}'::jsonb AND (jsonb_typeof("pending_mutation"->'tunnelName') = 'string' AND length("pending_mutation"->>'tunnelName') BETWEEN 1 AND 253))
    OR ("pending_mutation"->>'action' = 'configure_tunnel' AND "pending_mutation" - ARRAY['action', 'stepId', 'tunnelId', 'tunnelName', 'origin']::text[] = '{}'::jsonb AND (jsonb_typeof("pending_mutation"->'tunnelId') = 'string' AND length("pending_mutation"->>'tunnelId') BETWEEN 1 AND 191) AND (jsonb_typeof("pending_mutation"->'tunnelName') = 'string' AND length("pending_mutation"->>'tunnelName') BETWEEN 1 AND 253) AND (
  jsonb_typeof("pending_mutation"->'origin') = 'object'
  AND ("pending_mutation"->'origin') - ARRAY['localHttpHost', 'localHttpPort']::text[] = '{}'::jsonb
  AND "pending_mutation"->'origin'->>'localHttpHost' IN ('localhost', '127.0.0.1', '::1', '[::1]')
  AND jsonb_typeof("pending_mutation"->'origin'->'localHttpPort') = 'number'
  AND ("pending_mutation"->'origin'->>'localHttpPort') ~ '^([1-9][0-9]{0,3}|[1-5][0-9]{4}|6[0-4][0-9]{3}|65[0-4][0-9]{2}|655[0-2][0-9]|6553[0-5])$'
))
    OR ("pending_mutation"->>'action' = 'delete_tunnel' AND "pending_mutation" - ARRAY['action', 'stepId', 'tunnelId', 'tunnelName']::text[] = '{}'::jsonb AND (jsonb_typeof("pending_mutation"->'tunnelId') = 'string' AND length("pending_mutation"->>'tunnelId') BETWEEN 1 AND 191) AND (jsonb_typeof("pending_mutation"->'tunnelName') = 'string' AND length("pending_mutation"->>'tunnelName') BETWEEN 1 AND 253))
    OR ("pending_mutation"->>'action' = 'create_dns' AND "pending_mutation" - ARRAY['action', 'stepId', 'hostname', 'tunnelId']::text[] = '{}'::jsonb AND (jsonb_typeof("pending_mutation"->'hostname') = 'string' AND length("pending_mutation"->>'hostname') BETWEEN 1 AND 253) AND (jsonb_typeof("pending_mutation"->'tunnelId') = 'string' AND length("pending_mutation"->>'tunnelId') BETWEEN 1 AND 191))
    OR ("pending_mutation"->>'action' = 'update_dns' AND "pending_mutation" - ARRAY['action', 'stepId', 'dnsRecordId', 'hostname', 'previousTunnelId', 'nextTunnelId']::text[] = '{}'::jsonb AND (jsonb_typeof("pending_mutation"->'dnsRecordId') = 'string' AND length("pending_mutation"->>'dnsRecordId') BETWEEN 1 AND 191) AND (jsonb_typeof("pending_mutation"->'hostname') = 'string' AND length("pending_mutation"->>'hostname') BETWEEN 1 AND 253) AND (jsonb_typeof("pending_mutation"->'previousTunnelId') = 'string' AND length("pending_mutation"->>'previousTunnelId') BETWEEN 1 AND 191) AND (jsonb_typeof("pending_mutation"->'nextTunnelId') = 'string' AND length("pending_mutation"->>'nextTunnelId') BETWEEN 1 AND 191))
    OR ("pending_mutation"->>'action' = 'delete_dns' AND "pending_mutation" - ARRAY['action', 'stepId', 'dnsRecordId', 'hostname', 'previousTunnelId']::text[] = '{}'::jsonb AND (jsonb_typeof("pending_mutation"->'dnsRecordId') = 'string' AND length("pending_mutation"->>'dnsRecordId') BETWEEN 1 AND 191) AND (jsonb_typeof("pending_mutation"->'hostname') = 'string' AND length("pending_mutation"->>'hostname') BETWEEN 1 AND 253) AND (jsonb_typeof("pending_mutation"->'previousTunnelId') = 'string' AND length("pending_mutation"->>'previousTunnelId') BETWEEN 1 AND 191))
  )
), false)
ddl.name: chk_managed_endpoint_pending
